stem: Rate of GST on essential commodities is ____.
solution: Essential commodities are exempt from GST, so the rate of GST on them is \(0\%\). Correct option: C.

stem: Out of the following equations which one is not a quadratic equation?
solution: In (A), \(x^2 + 4x = 11 + x^2\) reduces to \(4x - 11 = 0\), a linear equation (the \(x^2\) terms cancel), so it is not quadratic. (B) \(x^2 - 4x = 0\), (C) \(5x^2 - 90 = 0\) and (D) \(2x^2 - 2x + 5 = 0\) are all quadratic. Correct option: A.

stem: To draw graph of \(4x + 5y = 19\), find the value of \(y\) when \(x = 1\).
solution: Put \(x = 1\) in \(4x + 5y = 19\): \(4 + 5y = 19\), so \(5y = 15\) and \(y = 3\). Correct option: B.

subtopic: Sum of n Terms of an A.P.
stem: Sum of first five multiples of 3 is ____.
solution: First five multiples of 3 are \(3, 6, 9, 12, 15\). Their sum \(= 3 + 6 + 9 + 12 + 15 = 45\). Correct option: A.

stem: On certain article if rate of CGST is \(9\%\), then what is the rate of GST?
solution: GST is shared equally as CGST and SGST, so rate of SGST \(= 9\%\) as well. Rate of GST \(=\) rate of CGST \(+\) rate of SGST \(= 9\% + 9\% = 18\%\).

When two coins are tossed simultaneously, write the sample space \(S\).
solution: Each coin can show Head (H) or Tail (T). Sample space \(S = \{HH, HT, TH, TT\}\), so \(n(S) = 4\).

stem: Write the following quadratic equation in the form \(ax^2 + bx + c = 0\): \(2y = 10 - y^2\).
solution: \(2y = 10 - y^2\). Bring all terms to one side: \(y^2 + 2y - 10 = 0\). This is in the form \(ay^2 + by + c = 0\) with \(a = 1,\ b = 2,\ c = -10\).
